question: Which Indian state does S. Jaishankar represent in the Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Dr. S. Jaishankar, India's Minister of External Affairs, represents the state of **Gujarat** in the Rajya Sabha.
 
• He was elected to the Rajya Sabha from Gujarat in **July 2019**.
 
• Dr. Jaishankar is a career diplomat and served as the Foreign Secretary of India before joining politics.
 
• The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of India's Parliament, and its members are elected by the legislative assemblies of states and union territories.
 
• Gujarat has been a prominent state in Indian politics, often represented by influential leaders in the Rajya Sabha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajya Sabha**

 
 
• The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of the Parliament of India, also known as the "Council of States."
 
• It consists of 245 members, of which 233 are elected by state legislatures and union territories, and 12 are nominated by the President of India.
 
• Members serve staggered six-year terms, with one-third retiring every two years.
 
• The Rajya Sabha plays a significant role in the legislative process, particularly in reviewing, amending, or approving bills proposed by the Lok Sabha.
 
 
 
• **Election Process for Rajya Sabha**
 
 
• Members are elected through single transferable votes by the elected members of state legislative assemblies.
 
• The number of Rajya Sabha members a state can elect depends on its population.
 
• The President of India nominates 12 members with expertise in fields like literature, science, art, and social service.
 
 
 
• **Role of Gujarat in Indian Politics**
 
 
• Gujarat is a politically significant state, often producing leaders who have played crucial roles in Indian politics.
 
• Prominent leaders like Narendra Modi (Prime Minister of India) and Amit Shah (Home Minister of India) hail from Gujarat.
 
 
 
• **S. Jaishankar**
 
 
• Dr. Subrahmanyam Jaishankar is an Indian diplomat turned politician, currently serving as India's Minister of External Affairs.
 
• He joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and was elected to the Rajya Sabha in July 2019.
 
• He is known for his expertise in foreign affairs and has represented India in numerous international forums.
